jobs.title: Graduate Planner
jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are Balfour Beatty. You may not know us by name, but you’ll recognise what we do. We’re a leading international infrastructure group, building, maintaining and improving infrastructure that supports communities for generations to come.

As a Graduate Planner, you'll join our 2027 Early Careers programme and gain hands-on experience while contributing to some of the UK's most significant infrastructure projects. From day one, you'll take on real responsibility, develop technical and professional skills, and work alongside experienced colleagues who will support your growth. You'll also be part of a supportive graduate community, building the skills, experience and industry-recognised accreditations needed for a successful career.

In this role, you’ll join one of our Balfour Beatty Power T&D teams as a Graduate Planner, based in Middlesbrough, supporting projects across UK.

 **What you'll be doing**

As a Graduate Planner you’ll play an important role in supporting the planning and successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects. Working alongside experienced planners, engineers, and project teams, you'll apply your academic knowledge in a practical environment while developing the technical, analytical, and professional skills needed for a successful career in project planning and project controls.

You'll gain experience developing and maintaining project programmes, monitoring performance, analysing progress data, and supporting project teams to achieve delivery objectives. Through a structured graduate development programme, you'll build expertise in planning, project controls, programme management, forecasting, and project delivery while working towards professional accreditation..

You’ll support with:

* Supporting the day-to-day planning function across projects, helping to ensure programmes remain accurate, updated, and aligned with delivery requirements
* Developing, maintaining, and updating short-term and long-term project programmes to reflect progress and project changes
* Managing and updating project and contractual programmes in line with reporting requirements and project objectives
* Monitoring project progress, analysing programme performance, and identifying variances, risks, and opportunities
* Supporting the collection, analysis, and presentation of progress and performance information to support project decision-making
* Applying planning techniques including sequencing, logic development, critical path analysis, resource planning, and forecasting
* Producing planning reports, programme updates, dashboards, and performance information for project teams and stakeholders
* Supporting project controls activities, including baseline management, change management, and programme assurance
* Working with project teams to understand project requirements, construction activities, and delivery strategies
* Supporting forecasting activities relating to labour, plant, materials, subcontractors, and project resources
* Building strong working relationships with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to support successful project delivery
* Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance programme management, reporting, and project performance
* Using industry-standard planning software and digital tools to support project planning and controls activities

 **Who we're looking for**

We value your potential over past experience and are looking for graduates with a degree in Construction Management/Construction Planning and a genuine interest in our industry. To be eligible, you’ll need to achieve a minimum 2:2 honours degree by the time you start.

We’d love to receive your application if you:

* Are curious, proactive and motivated to develop professionally.
* Enjoy solving problems and finding practical solutions.
* Work well with others and build positive relationships.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with different people.
* Take ownership, adapt to challenges and are committed to achieving results.

Please note that this role may require travel to various locations, which means you may occasionally need to work and stay away from home. Flexibility is essential, as assignments can vary based on project needs. All reasonable travel and accommodation expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy. Before joining Balfour Beatty, you must hold a full UK driver's license.

 **Why work for us as a Graduate**

* Work on high-profile projects that make a real difference, while building your career with one of the UK’s leading infrastructure groups.
* Be part of a supportive early careers network, with structured training and with structured training and coaching from experienced industry professionals.
* Take part in unique development experiences, including residential trips in the Lake District and personal development delivered by our external partners.
* Take ownership of your ongoing professional development, with support towards professional membership and chartership or professional registration where relevant to your career path.

**What we can offer you**

* Competitive salary and flexible benefits, giving you the freedom to shape a rewards package that works for you.
* 25 days' holiday, with the option to buy or sell additional days.
* A permanent contract from day one, reflecting our commitment to your long-term career.
* Clear progression opportunities, with bi-annual performance and pay reviews throughout your programme.
* Opportunities to connect with fellow graduates through networking events, development activities and our Early Careers Showcase.
* Opportunities to get involved in wider business initiatives, community projects and programmes such as the Duke of Edinburgh's Award.

jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham
jobs.description:
Town Planning

UKIMEA Region



BIR0000SX Requisition #

Graduate Town Planner - Birmingham or Nottingham

See it differently - Early Careers at Arup

See it differently

You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.

Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.

The Opportunity

With 150 town planners across 17 UK offices, Arup's Town Planning team works on some of the UK's most high-profile and complex projects, providing end-to-end planning and policy advice to public authorities, infrastructure providers, developers, property companies and landowners. Our work spans planning policy, spatial strategy, regeneration, major infrastructure planning, development management and research, helping to deliver more sustainable, resilient and inclusive places. As part of a multidisciplinary firm, we work closely with engineers, environmental specialists, urban designers and economists to tackle challenges such as housing delivery, climate change and infrastructure provision.

The role would be based within either our Birmingham or Nottingham offices, working as part of a wider national network of town planners. We are working on projects of national significance that will shape the future of the region. Our infrastructure work includes planning for the sustainable growth of Birmingham Airport, ensuring that the region has the energy it needs by planning for major new grid connections as well as working on new nationally important reservoirs. Our policy work includes working with both the East Midlands and West Midlands Combined Authorities to support the preparation of Spatial Development Strategies and establishing an exciting new vision for Nottingham’s future regeneration.

In this role you will:

Support the preparation of planning applications, planning policy documents, spatial strategies and evidence-based studies for public and private sector clients.

Undertake research, data analysis and report writing to inform planning, development, regeneration and major infrastructure projects, applying digital tools, GIS and AI-assisted techniques to interrogate evidence and communicate findings clearly.

Contribute to environmental, socio-economic and other impact assessments that support planning and consent processes.

Assist with stakeholder and community engagement activities, including workshops, consultations and meetings.

Work collaboratively as part of multi-disciplinary teams with planners, engineers, urban designers, environmental specialists, economists and other experts to deliver sustainable and inclusive places.

Help us use digital and AI tools well – from spatial data, dashboards and visualisation to automating routine policy and site analysis – so that our advice is quicker to produce, easier to understand and better evidenced.

https://www.arup.com/projects/ratcliffe-on-soar-power-station-site/

Is this role right for you?

For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes:

An undergraduate or bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as Urban Planning, Architecture, Geography & Geospatial Science or Urban Design. RTPI-accredited degrees are preferred, and we will support you through your RTPI Assessment of Professional Competence.

Desirable technical skills include experience using GIS, mapping or spatial analysis software (e.g. ArcGIS or QGIS); comfort with data handling and visualisation tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI); and a practical, critical interest in how AI and automation can be applied responsibly to planning tasks such as evidence review, consultation analysis, site appraisal and reporting.

To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:

Full working rights in the country of application

No more than 12 months of full-time experience in a comparable role

Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes;

* Changemakers: You care about sustainable development and want to see your work make a genuine difference.

* Innovative minds: You think critically, ask hard questions, and are genuinely open to new approaches.

* Growth seekers: You are curious, actively seek feedback, and look for ways to keep developing.

* Adaptable adventurers: You are comfortable with uncertainty and adapt readily as projects and priorities evolve.

You should be able to start this opportunity on **1 September 2027.**

**Advert Closing Date:** **16 October 2026**

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.

**Eligibility:**

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.

What we offer you

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us th

jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
Description:

**RMC is seeking a GIS Analyst for a full-time hybrid position in New Orleans, LA or Arlington, VA!**

Are you ready to embark on a fulfilling and impactful career journey with Risk Mitigation Consulting (RMC)? We're in search of an exceptional GIS Analyst to become a part of our mission-driven team, dedicated to making a difference in the federal and commercial markets. At RMC, we're all about enhancing security for both our military and global commercial partners, offering an array of services such as Risk Management, Mission Assurance, and Cybersecurity.

Our team's well-being is paramount, and we reflect this commitment through our flexible work environment and exceptional company culture. By joining RMC, you become a key contributor to our mission – **Assuring Tomorrow!**

When you join RMC, you'll experience a range of benefits, including:

* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans fully covered for employees
  + Subsidized dependent health care coverage
* Participation in our Annual Bonus Program
* Life insurance policy equivalent to 1x your annual salary.
* Company paid short and long-term disability
* Cell phone reimbursement of $65 per month
* 401(k) Plan with contributions
* A 401(k) Safe Harbor Employer Contribution Program, which includes a 3% contribution

**Position Summary:**

The GIS Analyst will support organizational components of Department of War in the development, maintenance, and enhancement of the web application relating to threats and hazard related GIS projects by integrating, analyzing, and visualizing threat, hazard, infrastructure, and mission-related data. This position will develop and maintain web-based GIS applications, dashboards, maps, and analytical products that support situational awareness and decision-making. The GIS Analyst will work collaboratively with technical staff and clients to understand requirements, manage and integrate diverse geospatial datasets, perform spatial analysis, and translate complex information into clear and effective visual products that enhance the security, resilience, and mission effectiveness of client infrastructure.

**Essential Functions:**

**GIS Platforms & Core GIS Skills**

* Experience with ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Enterprise
* Knowledge of database management, design, and geospatial data organization
* Strong abilities in data manipulation, conversion, integration, and spatial analysis
* Ability to document workflows and write methodology papers
* Experience with raster and multidimensional analysis at large scales
* Provides technical guidance and expertise in GIS analysis, data management, visualization, and web application development

**Programming, Automation & Data Workflows**

* Strong knowledge of programming and automation using Python, SQL, and/or ModelBuilder
* Experience and ability building and maintaining automated pipelines that pull, process, and combine large multi-source geospatial datasets, raster and vector both, at a global or regional scale
* Implement testing, validation, checkpointing, and error handling for automated workflows
* Experience with uploading, documenting, and maintaining python code on Github enterprise

**Threat, Hazard & Risk Analysis**

* Demonstrates GIS knowledge in identifying, mapping, analyzing, and visualizing threat and hazard data to support situational awareness and decision-making
* Ability to support the development of spatial analysis methodologies and workflows used to assess threats, hazards, and risks
* Basic knowledge of the functions of infrastructure, including telecommunications (IT, telephone, satellite, radio), electricity transmission and distribution, natural gas distribution, water infrastructure (drinking water, storm water drainage, sewage collection and disposal), transportation networks, emergency response, and physical security assets

**Web GIS, Mapping & Visualization**

* Experience developing and maintaining GIS web applications such as Experience Builder and Dashboard applications
* Ability to develop maps, dashboards, and visual products through collaboration and communication with clients Military & Project Environment
* Experience working in or supporting military environments, with an understanding of military organizational structures, ranks, terminology, protocols, and professional etiquette
* Contributes to project planning and collaborates with other team members to ensure project goals and client requirements are met

**Innovation & Professional Development**

* Regularly explores advancements in GIS technology, attends training or industry events, and implements innovative tools to improve workflows and deliver effective GIS solutions

**Competencies:**

* Experience with ArcGIS Applications, including Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, Web Maps, Survey123, and/or ArcGIS Knowledge
* Experience working with ArcGIS Enterprise environments and web-based GIS applications
* Experience with database administration and management, including PostgreSQL and/or enterprise geodatabases.
* Experience working with REST Services, Feature Services, and Web Feature Layers
* Knowledge of programming or scripting using JavaScript, C++, C#, and/or Python
* Experience with GIS data publishing, layer configuration, and integration into web applications
* Basic understanding of Excel functions, data formatting, manipulation, and data preparation
* Ability to troubleshoot GIS applications, data, and dashboard functionality
* Understanding GEOINT, all-hazards threat assessment, risk analysis, or mission assurance concepts is a plus

Requirements:

**Education & Experience:**

* 3-6 years of GIS work experience

**Required Certificates & Licenses:**

* Cartography, Computer Science, Geography, Geographic Information Systems

**Desired Certificates & Licenses:**

* Cartography, Computer Science, Geography, Geographic Information Systems, GEOINT Certificate plus 4 years of experience rela

**About the role**

We are Balfour Beatty. You may not know us by name, but you’ll recognise what we do. We’re a leading international infrastructure group, building, maintaining and improving infrastructure that supports communities for generations to come.

As a Graduate Planner, you'll join our 2027 Early Careers programme and gain hands-on experience while contributing to some of the UK's most significant infrastructure projects. From day one, you'll take on real responsibility, develop technical and professional skills, and work alongside experienced colleagues who will support your growth. You'll also be part of a supportive graduate community, building the skills, experience and industry-recognised accreditations needed for a successful career.

In this role, you’ll join one of our Balfour Beatty Power T&D teams as a Graduate Planner, based in Middlesbrough, supporting projects across UK.

 **What you'll be doing**

As a Graduate Planner you’ll play an important role in supporting the planning and successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects. Working alongside experienced planners, engineers, and project teams, you'll apply your academic knowledge in a practical environment while developing the technical, analytical, and professional skills needed for a successful career in project planning and project controls.

You'll gain experience developing and maintaining project programmes, monitoring performance, analysing progress data, and supporting project teams to achieve delivery objectives. Through a structured graduate development programme, you'll build expertise in planning, project controls, programme management, forecasting, and project delivery while working towards professional accreditation..

You’ll support with:

* Supporting the day-to-day planning function across projects, helping to ensure programmes remain accurate, updated, and aligned with delivery requirements
* Developing, maintaining, and updating short-term and long-term project programmes to reflect progress and project changes
* Managing and updating project and contractual programmes in line with reporting requirements and project objectives
* Monitoring project progress, analysing programme performance, and identifying variances, risks, and opportunities
* Supporting the collection, analysis, and presentation of progress and performance information to support project decision-making
* Applying planning techniques including sequencing, logic development, critical path analysis, resource planning, and forecasting
* Producing planning reports, programme updates, dashboards, and performance information for project teams and stakeholders
* Supporting project controls activities, including baseline management, change management, and programme assurance
* Working with project teams to understand project requirements, construction activities, and delivery strategies
* Supporting forecasting activities relating to labour, plant, materials, subcontractors, and project resources
* Building strong working relationships with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders to support successful project delivery
* Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance programme management, reporting, and project performance
* Using industry-standard planning software and digital tools to support project planning and controls activities

 **Who we're looking for**

We value your potential over past experience and are looking for graduates with a degree in Construction Management/Construction Planning and a genuine interest in our industry. To be eligible, you’ll need to achieve a minimum 2:2 honours degree by the time you start.

We’d love to receive your application if you:

* Are curious, proactive and motivated to develop professionally.
* Enjoy solving problems and finding practical solutions.
* Work well with others and build positive relationships.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with different people.
* Take ownership, adapt to challenges and are committed to achieving results.

Please note that this role may require travel to various locations, which means you may occasionally need to work and stay away from home. Flexibility is essential, as assignments can vary based on project needs. All reasonable travel and accommodation expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy. Before joining Balfour Beatty, you must hold a full UK driver's license.

 **Why work for us as a Graduate**

* Work on high-profile projects that make a real difference, while building your career with one of the UK’s leading infrastructure groups.
* Be part of a supportive early careers network, with structured training and with structured training and coaching from experienced industry professionals.
* Take part in unique development experiences, including residential trips in the Lake District and personal development delivered by our external partners.
* Take ownership of your ongoing professional development, with support towards professional membership and chartership or professional registration where relevant to your career path.

**What we can offer you**

* Competitive salary and flexible benefits, giving you the freedom to shape a rewards package that works for you.
* 25 days' holiday, with the option to buy or sell additional days.
* A permanent contract from day one, reflecting our commitment to your long-term career.
* Clear progression opportunities, with bi-annual performance and pay reviews throughout your programme.
* Opportunities to connect with fellow graduates through networking events, development activities and our Early Careers Showcase.
* Opportunities to get involved in wider business initiatives, community projects and programmes such as the Duke of Edinburgh's Award.

new_jobs.title: GIS Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Description:

**RMC is seeking a GIS Analyst for a full-time hybrid position in New Orleans, LA or Arlington, VA!**

Are you ready to embark on a fulfilling and impactful career journey with Risk Mitigation Consulting (RMC)? We're in search of an exceptional GIS Analyst to become a part of our mission-driven team, dedicated to making a difference in the federal and commercial markets. At RMC, we're all about enhancing security for both our military and global commercial partners, offering an array of services such as Risk Management, Mission Assurance, and Cybersecurity.

Our team's well-being is paramount, and we reflect this commitment through our flexible work environment and exceptional company culture. By joining RMC, you become a key contributor to our mission – **Assuring Tomorrow!**

When you join RMC, you'll experience a range of benefits, including:

* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans fully covered for employees
  + Subsidized dependent health care coverage
* Participation in our Annual Bonus Program
* Life insurance policy equivalent to 1x your annual salary.
* Company paid short and long-term disability
* Cell phone reimbursement of $65 per month
* 401(k) Plan with contributions
* A 401(k) Safe Harbor Employer Contribution Program, which includes a 3% contribution

**Position Summary:**

The GIS Analyst will support organizational components of Department of War in the development, maintenance, and enhancement of the web application relating to threats and hazard related GIS projects by integrating, analyzing, and visualizing threat, hazard, infrastructure, and mission-related data. This position will develop and maintain web-based GIS applications, dashboards, maps, and analytical products that support situational awareness and decision-making. The GIS Analyst will work collaboratively with technical staff and clients to understand requirements, manage and integrate diverse geospatial datasets, perform spatial analysis, and translate complex information into clear and effective visual products that enhance the security, resilience, and mission effectiveness of client infrastructure.

**Essential Functions:**

**GIS Platforms & Core GIS Skills**

* Experience with ArcGIS Desktop, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Enterprise
* Knowledge of database management, design, and geospatial data organization
* Strong abilities in data manipulation, conversion, integration, and spatial analysis
* Ability to document workflows and write methodology papers
* Experience with raster and multidimensional analysis at large scales
* Provides technical guidance and expertise in GIS analysis, data management, visualization, and web application development

**Programming, Automation & Data Workflows**

* Strong knowledge of programming and automation using Python, SQL, and/or ModelBuilder
* Experience and ability building and maintaining automated pipelines that pull, process, and combine large multi-source geospatial datasets, raster and vector both, at a global or regional scale
* Implement testing, validation, checkpointing, and error handling for automated workflows
* Experience with uploading, documenting, and maintaining python code on Github enterprise

**Threat, Hazard & Risk Analysis**

* Demonstrates GIS knowledge in identifying, mapping, analyzing, and visualizing threat and hazard data to support situational awareness and decision-making
* Ability to support the development of spatial analysis methodologies and workflows used to assess threats, hazards, and risks
* Basic knowledge of the functions of infrastructure, including telecommunications (IT, telephone, satellite, radio), electricity transmission and distribution, natural gas distribution, water infrastructure (drinking water, storm water drainage, sewage collection and disposal), transportation networks, emergency response, and physical security assets

**Web GIS, Mapping & Visualization**

* Experience developing and maintaining GIS web applications such as Experience Builder and Dashboard applications
* Ability to develop maps, dashboards, and visual products through collaboration and communication with clients Military & Project Environment
* Experience working in or supporting military environments, with an understanding of military organizational structures, ranks, terminology, protocols, and professional etiquette
* Contributes to project planning and collaborates with other team members to ensure project goals and client requirements are met

**Innovation & Professional Development**

* Regularly explores advancements in GIS technology, attends training or industry events, and implements innovative tools to improve workflows and deliver effective GIS solutions

**Competencies:**

* Experience with ArcGIS Applications, including Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, Web Maps, Survey123, and/or ArcGIS Knowledge
* Experience working with ArcGIS Enterprise environments and web-based GIS applications
* Experience with database administration and management, including PostgreSQL and/or enterprise geodatabases.
* Experience working with REST Services, Feature Services, and Web Feature Layers
* Knowledge of programming or scripting using JavaScript, C++, C#, and/or Python
* Experience with GIS data publishing, layer configuration, and integration into web applications
* Basic understanding of Excel functions, data formatting, manipulation, and data preparation
* Ability to troubleshoot GIS applications, data, and dashboard functionality
* Understanding GEOINT, all-hazards threat assessment, risk analysis, or mission assurance concepts is a plus

Requirements:

**Education & Experience:**

* 3-6 years of GIS work experience

**Required Certificates & Licenses:**

* Cartography, Computer Science, Geography, Geographic Information Systems

**Desired Certificates & Licenses:**

* Cartography, Computer Science, Geography, Geographic Information Systems, GEOINT Certificate plus 4 years of experience rela
